title: 🧠 Moves, News and Ask Claude
notes: 🧠 Research → Moves tells you what to do: sell aging value when your window is closing, buy at a thin position when you're contending, turn surplus into a starter, or grab a hot waiver add. Each one comes with real, fair offers from the trade calculator. Tap Load into proposal to open it on the Trade Desk.
📰 Research → News shows recent articles on your players, refreshed every morning and Sunday at noon. Player cards show the latest news too.
🤖 Research → Ask copies your team's full data and opens Claude on your own Claude account. Paste and ask anything. Free accounts work, and it costs the league nothing.
